v4.9.073 - a sync leaves the screen alone (#347)

Two halves, both in the pull, both found by reading rather than guessing.

The rebuild set currentViewMode: 'both', fsOverlayActive: null, ovExpandedFid:
null and showText: {} on EVERY pull. A sync reset the view to a default, forgot
fullscreen was open, collapsed an expanded card and shut open text panels. Until
#342 the default was then turned into 3x2 by the "which view does this project
open in" rule, which is why it always looked like a march back to the grid.

And the pull's own "put the view back" called setViewMode every time, even when
the mode had not changed. setViewMode does more than set a mode - it collapses
an expanded card and tears down the scribble layer, because those belong to the
view being left. So expanding a card in 3x2 and waiting for a sync put you back
at the plain grid. It now only runs when the view actually moved.

Also in: #346 the app writes a line when its view changes and what caused it;
#344 nothing may happen when nothing is happening; #345 the ledger and a random
day, so the simulator stops only finding what I thought to script.
